technology_name: Recombinant Viral Antigens for Diagnostics and Vaccines
problem_solved: Limitations in scalability, safety, and structural/functional fidelity when producing highly specific viral proteins using traditional native antigen isolation methods.
description: A robust protein expression platform using recombinant DNA technology to synthesize highly specific, safe, and scalable viral antigens. The platform features established optimization protocols and proprietary expression vectors tailored for two distinct pipelines: a fast, cost-effective E. coli bacterial system for rapid scalability, and a mammalian HEK293 cell platform capable of executing complex post-translational modifications, correct folding, and disulfide bond formations. Downstream processing is supported by automated ÄKTA pure™ chromatography systems for high-yield, high-purity isolation.
applications:
• Production of raw antigenic proteins for commercial diagnostic kit manufacturing (ELISA, Lateral Flow)

• Development of subunit vaccine candidates and clinical therapeutic proteins

• Contract research services for structural biology and target validation programs

• Standardized supply chains for academic, industrial, and clinical research reagents
